description: This is a Java source test class for the Apache Fineract project, specifically testing loan capitalized income functionalities including amortization, adjustments, reversals, and edge cases like overpayment and loan closure.

classes.name: LoanCapitalizedIncomeTest
classes.description: Test class for verifying the functionality of capitalized income handling in loans including amortization, adjustments, reversals, overpayment handling, and boundary conditions within the Apache Fineract platform.

classes.name: LoanCapitalizedIncomeTest
